stories.headline: Perez Hilton hospitalized after reports he livestreamed self-harm, sheriff’s officials say - NBC News
stories.summary: The blogger recently returned to his native Miami after living in Las Vegas.
stories.why: Perez Hilton's hospitalization marks a reckoning for a guy who built his brand on publicly destroying others—for men who grew up watching him, it's a gut-check about whether that era of celebrity cruelty still matters or if we've collectively moved on.

stories.headline: ‘Spider-Man: Brand New Day’ Has So Many Easter Eggs in Its Graphics - Gizmodo
stories.summary: One of the film's designers has been posting some amazing work on social media.
stories.why: Spider-Man's visual design obsession signals that movies now compete for attention through social-media-friendly Easter eggs and behind-the-scenes content—if you're not following the designer's posts, you're missing half the film.

stories.headline: How Ariana Grande’s body became political - Salon.com
stories.summary: MAGA influencers want women not just thin, but weak
stories.why: When political movements start dictating women's body types as ideological statements, men need to recognize they're being sold a specific vision of power and control that goes way beyond attraction—it's about domination.

stories.headline: Duane ‘Keffe D’ Davis, charged with organizing the killing of Tupac Shakur, is on trial - NBC News
stories.summary: Duane ‘Keffe D’ Davis, who prosecutors say orchestrated the 1996 killing of rap icon Tupac Shakur, is going to trial almost 30 years after the fatal drive-by shooting in Las Vegas.
stories.why: The Tupac case closing after 30 years is cultural closure for the generation that grew up during East Coast-West Coast beef, settling a real-world consequence of a rivalry that defined '90s hip-hop for men now in their 40s.

stories.headline: Eli Roth Admits ‘Ice Cream Man’ Features Generative AI After He “Mispoke” About Using The Technology - Deadline
stories.summary: Eli Roth says his new horror 'Ice Cream Man' features generative AI after admitting he "misspoke" about using the technology.
stories.why: Eli Roth's AI admission reveals that big directors are already using generative tools and lying about it—if you're watching films expecting human craft, you need to know creators are shifting the goalposts without permission.

stories.headline: New "Ted Lasso" season features NWSL's Kansas City Current as plot point - espn.com
stories.summary: The new season of "Ted Lasso" was filmed in the U.S. at a real-life NWSL club for a cameo that serves as a key plot point of the show.
stories.why: Ted Lasso using a real women's soccer team as a plot device isn't just product placement—it signals that mainstream media is finally treating women's sports as culturally central enough for prestige TV, changing what men should expect to care about.

stories.headline: Barry Manilow cancels Kentucky concert minutes before showtime - Page Six
stories.summary: The show was originally scheduled for March 9 but was postponed as Manilow recovered from surgery for lung cancer.
stories.why: Manilow canceling due to lung cancer is a reminder that even icons don't get immortality—for men watching their heroes age, it's a hard check on mortality and what legacy actually means.
